name: Present
shape_prompt: Stylized 3D game prop, chunky vinyl-toy style, smooth sculpted rounded forms, quirky proportions. A small wrapped Christmas present cube with puffy rounded edges, a wide ribbon crossing over the top and down every side, and a big loop bow on top. Clean simple shapes, single object, no base.
texture_prompt: Bright saturated colours, smooth soft vinyl-toy finish, clean hand-painted look. Glossy red wrapping paper with small white snowflakes, wide golden-yellow ribbon and bow. No text, no logos.

assemble._note: placePresent scales by the Box's largest side, so the size here only sets proportions.
